lead.text: Nothing cleared our bar today, and last week was quiet too.

review.big_picture: Last week was quiet. No finding cleared our bar, so there is no result to review and none to single out. The record is still short, and we would rather say so than pad this page. A quiet week is not evidence for or against the hope that AI is speeding up discovery. We keep reading the sources every morning and will report a result as soon as one clears the bar.
